title: Independently audit HPE energy-radix full matrices
body:
Independently corroborates Arham Tahir’s PR #1906 at `788848032c16bbe0a543c1186c6691c66131c090`. A separately written closed literal parser and direct integer realification reconstruct all six pinned HPE matrices, without importing the predecessor parser/interpreter, using adjoints, or accepting a packed fingerprint. All 3,072 complex rows and 6,291,456 real entries agree across the three normalized pairs; the complete row digests and energies match the predecessor receipt. This closes the finite forward/adjoint independence gap left by its sampled correspondence check. No discrepancy or new radix bound is claimed.

Only `research/hpe-energy-independent-audit/` is added. It includes exact source pins, the unmodified attributed PR1906 receipt, a deterministic audit receipt, a task card and a registered replay. A separate exact-circuit specialist reviewed the all-dimension energy/sharpness argument, valid-gate unitarity, normalization and the new code. This is independent AI review, not human or Lean review.

Validation: CPython 3.12.12 on macOS arm64 registered replay passes, including seven test groups, 585 complete short-word comparisons against dense Gaussian-rational matrices, phase/character/scale controls, equivalent presentations, seven checksum-free receipt corruptions, detector-removal sensitivity, missing evidence, explicit regeneration and optimized read-only relocation. The direct oracle also passes under optimized CPython 3.14.6. The pinned predecessor’s direct verifier, selected-record integrity and whitespace checks pass. Hosted CI is separate.

Reproduce: `python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/hpe-energy-independent-audit`.

Scope: written proof review plus finite literal-matrix verification. No new Lean proof/build, supplier cold replay, canonical-frame derivation, physical hosting, precision/tape cost, full multiplication theorem, or new kappa. The source-specific parser is not a general Lean parser; source authentication is material. Formalize the energy-kernel lemma and guarded-gate row norms before adopting the reduced-radix checker.

Credit PR1906/Arham Tahir, PR1859/woklerx, PR593/Jeremy Kothe, commdata2338’s earlier semantic-binding work, PR1781/Sagar Thakrar’s distinct recipe census, and the retained Clifford/Lemma A/G lineage. Prepared for Ross with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, Apache-2.0. Current-main base `0b1cccf86e2f5132ed286a26ef0a681a495740ea`; selector nonce `cfbe139628a1920458d65ac59391c82d`, independent-verification / refined formal-interface-lemma. [Claim and audit discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1896#discussioncomment-18925662).

Final overlap refresh: 582 open PRs (including drafts) and 563 Discussion/comment/reply records, complete pagination and no warnings at 2026-10-14 14:20–14:22 UTC. The nearest results are the deliberately audited PR1906, predecessor PR1859 and their coordination thread. Titles/bodies and indexed local notes are covered, not every diff or nested source; no novelty proof is claimed. PR1906 and main remained at their pinned heads.
